To complete these enhancements, our certified technicians carefully open the manufacturer’s sealed packaging for inspection, testing, and precise installation according to the advertised specifications. All systems and components are brand new. Warranty service is handled directly by IST Computers, not the manufacturer. The ASUS Chromebook Plus CX34 features a thin, light and exceptionally durable design that keeps users productive and entertained from anywhere, weighing only 3.22 lbs, meeting rigorous MIL-STD 810H military standards for reliable performance even in harsh conditions, and delivering up to 10 hours of battery life to support uninterrupted work, study, media viewing and seamless connectivity, making it perfect for travel, daily commutes, or working on the go. It comes equipped with comprehensive AI-powered Google and Adobe tools to turn creative inspiration into reality faster, with its integrated Gemini AI simplifying the process of organizing creative drafts and optimizing materials, enabling users to write like a professional, design unique backgrounds, and reimagine photos all through the power of generative AI, and every purchase of this Chromebook Plus unlocks 12 months of Google AI Pro, granting access to Gemini Advanced, NotebookLM, 2TB of cloud storage, and boosted productivity with Gemini seamlessly integrated into Gmail, Docs and more Google applications. At its core, this device is powered by the 10-Core Intel Core i5-1335U Processor paired with Intel UHD Graphics to ensure smooth, consistent performance for everyday tasks, featuring 8GB LPDDR5X RAM for fast, efficient multitasking and 256GB of storage (128GB+128GB SD Card) that offers ample space for files, media, apps and more, while delivering fast storage access and reduced load times for all daily workflows. It delivers excellent visuals through its 14" FHD (1920 x 1080) IPS touchscreen with an anti-glare coating, which renders vibrant, crisp visuals and responsive touch performance, and it supports connecting up to three external monitors via HDMI or USB Type-C at up to 4K (3840 x 2160) resolution at 60Hz without the need for a docking station, while its 1080p webcam with a privacy shutter ensures crystal-clear video calls while protecting user privacy at all times. For rich, flexible connectivity options, it is fully equipped with 2x USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 ports, 2x USB-A 3.2 Gen 1 ports, HDMI 1.4, and a headphone/microphone combo jack, and features advanced Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.2 for blazing-fast wireless speeds and seamless, stable pairing with a wide range of wireless devices. Powered by ChromeOS with an Auto Update Expiration (AUE) date of Jun 2032, this Chromebook is built for the modern way of working and learning, with access to thousands of apps, built-in cloud backup, and full Google Assistant support, offering a fast, secure, and always up-to-date platform that delivers a simple, versatile, and reliable computing experience for everyday productivity, study, and entertainment. Purpose-built for education and business use, this device is ideal for students, teachers, IT admins, and business professionals who need a secure, cloud-first computing solution, perfect for online classes, test taking, document collaboration, and video conferencing via Google Meet or Zoom, effortlessly handling spreadsheets, presentations, and multiple browser tabs at once, making it an excellent fit for K12 schools, hybrid workplaces, and remote teams.
